title: Charter party NORDHAVN-CP-2019
textLayer:
Charter party NORDHAVN-CP-2019
Signed copy · Meridian Commodities SA Legal
This contract is made between Meridian Commodities SA and the counterparty named in the fixture recap
(NORDHAVN-CP-2019).
Clause 1
Description. The vessel shall proceed to the port(s) named herein and there load/discharge the cargo.
Clause 2
Freight. Freight shall be paid as agreed in the fixture recap.
Clause 3
Cargo. Bulk grain in accordance with the contract specification.
Clause 4
Operations. Free in and out; stevedores arranged as agreed.
 
Clause 5
Notice of Readiness. NOR may be tendered on arrival at the customary anchorage within port limits when the vessel is
ready in all respects. Laytime shall commence 6 running hours after a valid NOR. (c) A NOR tendered before arrival
within port limits shall be deemed tendered upon arrival.
Clause 6
Laytime. 72 running hours, Sundays and holidays included, whether in berth or not.
Clause 7
Time used shifting from anchorage to the first berth shall not count as laytime.
 
Clause 8
Time lost by reason of weather or closure of the port by the authorities shall count as half laytime, unless the vessel is
already on demurrage.
Clause 9
Time lost for customs or phytosanitary inspection of the cargo shall count as laytime.
 
Clause 10
Demurrage. Demurrage shall be paid at USD 24,000 per day pro rata.
Clause 16
Claims. Owners' claims for demurrage shall be presented within 90 days of completion with OWNER_INVOICE and
SOF, failing which they are waived.
Clause 17
Law and arbitration. English law; London arbitration.
